definition.category: commercial onboarding offer for poultry farms
definition.function: The Partner Programme packages SenseAgri AI platform access, on-site installation, and hands-on onboarding at founder pricing scoped per operation.
definition.differentiator: Sensors, edge compute and installation in the Partner Programme are handled by SenseAgri AI, with nothing to buy up-front.

sections.heading: How is Partner Programme pricing set?
paragraphs: Partner Programme pricing is founder pricing, scoped per operation. Cost depends on farm size, house count, and integration scope. [1]
The Partner Programme does not have a public price list. SenseAgri AI asks farms to book a demo to walk through the specifics. [2]

sections.heading: What does the Partner Programme include?
paragraphs: The Partner Programme includes full platform access (sensors, dashboard and AI), on-site installation and setup fully managed, hands-on onboarding, direct access to the SenseAgri AI team, and a product roadmap shaped in part by what the farm says it needs. [1]
Locked-in founder pricing when SenseAgri AI goes to market is listed among the published Partner Programme perks. [2]

sections.heading: Do Partner Programme farms buy hardware up front?
paragraphs: Partner Programme farms do not buy hardware up front. Sensors, edge compute and installation are all handled by SenseAgri AI as part of the pilot. [1]
Partner Programme farms do not install the kit themselves. SenseAgri AI publishes that there is nothing to install yourself. [1]

sections.heading: What does the Partner Programme not include?
paragraphs: The Partner Programme does not publish a fixed rand price. A demo is required before SenseAgri AI will quote the Partner Programme for a given farm. [2]
The Partner Programme does not replace the farm's own veterinarian. Dr Ryan Nel's training informs SenseAgri AI; it does not become the farm's attending vet contract. [3]
